spec_match.rationale: Answers the three support APIs for six IAMF strings with controls, but no concept on the feature actually feeds IAMF bytes through MediaSource and plays them, which is the shipped capability.

interactive.rationale: "Probe again" re-runs all three APIs (identical, deterministic results here); the verdict summary and table are live, not hard-coded.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Matches the "three APIs, one question" framing on the index.

edge_cases.rationale: Known-good opus/AAC controls and an invented codec make a "no" interpretable.

references.rationale: Cites chromestatus.com/feature/<id> in the see-also block plus the spec/explainer.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite 6/6 PASS here and pairs the IAMF strings with a known-good control and an invented codec, so a negative cannot come from a broken probe.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Playwright headless Chromium 153.0.8010.12 against a local server on :3109 (chrome-devtools-mcp not available to this pass): 6/6 IAMF strings reported supported, controls and the negative row behaved, console/network clean; not a chrome-devtools-mcp/Canary pass, and no accessibility-tree inspection.

telemetry_health.rationale: showcaseTelemetry is loaded and the page records named assertions for its main measurement; no unexpected errors seen.

design_system.rationale: Inline styles use the design-system variables; button overrides keep text/background pairs readable; not a static card.

accessibility.rationale: Native, labelled controls (no unnamed controls found), visible focus on a Tab walk, and results surfaced as text in status/output regions.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: At 360×740 documentElement.scrollWidth === innerWidth (wide content scrolls inside its own container) and desktop 1280×800 lays out cleanly.

openQuestions.title: Add a real MSE playback concept with a small IAMF fixture
openQuestions.detail: Every IAMF concept stops at support queries or a typed <source> list pointing at non-existent files. The shipped feature is decoding IAMF via Media Source Extensions; a concept that appends a short committed IAMF (Opus substreams) init+media segment to a SourceBuffer, plays it, and reports decoded channel layout / error events would cover the practical-product angle of the portfolio.

guidanceConsulted.query: audio media element source fallback codec detection with canPlayType and MediaCapabilities
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Do not preload media data the user has not asked for; let the element choose sources by type before fetching.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Observed: the pages only query support APIs and type-gated <source> lists; no media bytes are preloaded. No change required by this critique.
